title: introduce polyglot delegated-auth proxy + consumer-friendly stream shims and SDK bumps (py/ts/go)
author: Samir Patel
release_notes: Bump Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs; add delegated-auth proxy and token-lease mode; introduce consumer-friendly stream view abstractions and reusable retry presets; no breaking changes by default; opt-in flags for new ergonomics.
description: Context: customers building multi-tenant connectors asked for a minimal delegated-auth pattern plus more ergonomic streaming consumers across languages. This PR implements a lightweight delegated-auth proxy interface on the platform client, a language-agnostic retry shim with named presets, and small ergonomic stream "views" that make pull-streams cancelable, checkpointable, and typed. Work spanned runtime client, SDK bindings (Python/TS/Go), and integration tests. Summary of changes: 1) Add DelegatedAuthProxy interface and server-side adapter (token-lease, bind-to-origin) so connectors can request short-lived tokens without embedding full service credentials. 2) Introduce RetryProfile DSL (latency-first, cost-first, durable) and a shim layer used by all SDKs so consumers can select behavior without wiring backoff params. 3) Implement StreamView abstractions: Python AsyncPullView (async iterator with checkpoint/seek), TypeScript PullStreamView (AsyncIterable with .checkpoint()), and Go CancelableIterator (context-aware Next/Close). 4) Small API ergonomics: typed envelopes for chunk frames, clearer error classes (TransientRetryableError, PermanentError), and improved README snippets. 5) SDK version bumps: python->2.7.0, typescript->1.9.0, go->1.14.2. 6) Tests: unit tests per SDK, e2e smoke tests against a local delegated-auth emulator, CI matrix added for cross-language integration. Checklist: - [x] design doc (ENG-3429) - [x] prototype (local) - [x] SDK bindings for py/ts/go - [x] docs/examples update - [x] integration tests - [x] release notes entry Motivation: reduce secret surface area for third-party connectors, standardize retry semantics across polyglot clients, and make streaming consumption less error-prone. Rollout: behind opt-in flags for existing customers; default behavior preserves prior semantics. Backwards compatibility: existing SDK call signatures still work; new types are additive or gated behind feature flags. CI notes: initial run failed on go linter (unused var) and flake8 in python; fix commits added. Merge strategy: squash and merge to keep SDK bumps atomic.

review_conversation: Alyssa Chen (reviewer): Can we make the default retry preset exactly preserve current backoff numbers so customers without opt-in see no behavioral change?
Samir Patel (author): Yes - RetryProfile default maps to the existing numeric backoff; added explicit test to guarantee parity.
Diego Ruiz (reviewer): The delegated auth API shape looks good but we should document threat model and recommended KMS rotations in docs/delegated-auth.md.
Samir Patel (author): Added a security section and clarified token lifetime recommendations.
Ivy Nguyen (reviewer): Go iterator Close semantics need to be deterministic on cancelled context; added a comment and a small refactor request.
Samir Patel (author): Addressed: CancelableIterator.Close now idempotently drains and cancels the internal context. CI green after lint fixes.
Marcus Li (approver): Approved and tested with local emulator; SDK bumps look safe.
qa_notes: Run ./examples/delegate-proxy/start.sh to run local emulator; exercise multi-tenant flow in examples/ with feature flag DELEGATE_AUTH=1. Verify RetryProfile selection by injecting a 503 on first request and asserting two retries for latency-first preset.
notes: This PR intentionally keeps changes opt-in. We'll follow up with telemetry to measure adoption before enabling by default for a customer cohort.
